findings.headline: This read of count returns its value from before setCount on line 6.
findings.why: In Solid 2.0.3 a setter queues its write, and reads keep returning the old value until the batch flushes in a microtask or flush() runs. Solid 1.x applied the write at once outside batch, so this code read the new value.
findings.guidance: Read what this function does with count after the write. Where it only needs the value it just wrote, use that value (keep it in a local) instead of reading count again. Where it needs the settled state, such as a memo derived from count, call flush() between the write and the read; flush is a dev error inside an action body and is not re-entrant inside onSettled or tracked effects, so restructure there instead.
